metadata.description: Typographic layout model, font-size vs size bounding box, wrapping algorithms, and property reference

rule.name: font_size_vs_size
rule.description: 'font-size: 24px;' controls typographic glyph scale. 'size: 400px;' (or 'width: 400px;') defines container bounding box width for multi-line word-wrapping. Without size/width, text elements measure intrinsically and flow across a single continuous line.

properties.property: Raw text string; \n for line breaks

rule.name: badge_and_pill_vertical_centering
rule.description: 2D Canvas/Skia text renderers position text at textBaseline = 'top', reserving space for ascenders and descenders. In tight UI containers (pills, badges, buttons, status chips: h = 20px-34px), text consisting of capital letters or numbers without descenders (e.g. 'COMPILED • 0 ERRORS', '4-Pass Math') will mathematically align its bounding box to center, but OPTICALLY appear 2-3px too high. To achieve true mathematical and optical dead-center alignment: 1. Always adjust the text y-position by a Cap-Height Offset: +1.5px to +2.5px (+3px to +5px @2x). 2. When pairing with SVG icons, align the visual center of the glyphs directly to the center of the icon bounds.
rule.verification_formula: Delta = (Text_minY - Container_minY) - (Container_maxY - Text_maxY) True center requires: |Delta| <= 0.5px. If Delta > 0.5px, shift text down.
